messages:
Noah Rivera: AegisPrime procurement just sent a vendor packet. They want: SOC2 Type II report, summary of most recent external penetration test, confirmation of incident notification SLA (they want 24h), DPA signature confirmation, and our data deletion policy for customer exports. They say PO is on hold until evidence is received. Deadline Tue COB.

Priya Nair: Thanks Noah. Legal preference: we can offer the standard DPA and confirm signature via DocuSign for enterprise deals. I won't attach the full SOC2 report in Slack  we provide a redacted SOC2 attestation and a bridge letter under NDA.

Devon Chen: For pen test: we can provide a high-level attestation: "Redwood conducts annual third-party penetration tests; summary findings and remediation status are available under NDA." For incident notification: our standard is initial acknowledgement within 12 hours for security incidents and notification within 24 hours for breaches affecting customer data, with follow-ups and a forensics report timeline. We should avoid committing stricter contractual SLAs without security/legal sign-off.

Noah Rivera: Good. Can we be procurement-friendly in one message? Short bullets and links to the redacted SOC2 + pen test attestation under NDA. Also they specifically asked whether we support automated deletion of exported customer data after X days.

Devon Chen: Data deletion policy: "Customers may request deletion of their account data; Hosted customers have deletion initiated within 7 business days and artifacts purged per our retention schedule unless preservation is required by law or an active support ticket. For Dedicated/Private deployments, deletion timelines depend on customer-managed infrastructure. We can enable an automated export-and-delete workflow as an enterprise feature." Keep it high-level.

Priya Nair: Add legal line: "Redwood will sign the standard DPA. For any deviation (e.g., custom data residency or deletion guarantees) please request enterprise amendment; legal review required."

OnboardBot: Task created: "Send AegisPrime compliance package (SOC2 attestation + pen test summary + DPA)" assigned to Noah Rivera, due 2025-10-21.

Jordan Kim: Flagging renewal/PO risk: procurement hold means revenue gating. If PO delayed > 7 days, escalate to AE and ops to prioritize evidence shipment. Noah, keep me posted when you send.

Noah Rivera: Drafting reply now  will paste procurement-friendly bullets and link to secure upload for NDA assets. Sending in ~15m and will tag @Priya for DPA sign-off and @Devon for the incident SLA phrasing.

Priya Nair: I'll be on standby to sign the DPA after review. Please do not attach full SOC2 on public channels; use secure upload and NDA request.

Devon Chen: I'll prepare the pen test attestation and a two-line incident SLA summary to paste.

Noah Rivera: Sent at 1938456255: pasted bullets, requested NDA for SOC2/pen test download, included Devon's SLA language and Priya's DPA note. Mentioned automated deletion policy and enterprise option for export-and-delete workflow.

Noah Rivera: AegisPrime procurement replied at 1938456280 asking whether the 12h initial acknowledgement applies to P1 tickets across Hosted and Dedicated. They also asked for a sample redacted SOC2 attestation now. I replied asking for NDA signature link (they agreed to sign). Looping in Devon to confirm P1 handling.

Devon Chen: P1 handling: initial acknowledgement within 12 hours for both Hosted and Dedicated. Full incident response timeline and remediation targets differ by deployment model; will include that note in the attestation.

Noah Rivera: Thanks all. Keeping replies concise and using NDA-protected artifacts should unstick procurement quickly and reduce renewal risk.
